name: Amanda Padilla
background: Amanda Padilla is a Jackson entrepreneur who ran as the Libertarian nominee for Senate District 17 in 2022. She lost the Nov. 8, 2022 general election.

In an Oct. 26, 2022 Jackson Hole News&Guide candidate feature, Padilla described herself as an entrepreneur from an early age, recalling that as a Girl Scout she sold more than 1,200 boxes of cookies. The same column identified her as the youngest candidate in that Senate District 17 field. Her 2022 Secretary of State general-election filing listed a Jackson mailing address.
